caption.en: Layered violet glass plumage resting on a raw branch—overlapping translucent scales softening into clear crystal along the belly.
caption.zh: 層疊紫晶琉璃羽片棲於粗獷枯枝上，半透明羽鱗向下漸融為純淨透明水晶腹身。

alt.en: Deep violet translucent glass bird sculpture with layered glass feathers perched on a tree branch
alt.zh: 停棲於樹枝上的深紫色半透明琉璃鳥雕塑，具層疊玻璃羽片與透明腹部
